name: Do I need to completely remove my existing lawn to create a water-wise landscape?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to completely remove my existing lawn to create a water-wise landscape?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. While many water-wise designs do involve removing traditional turf grass, especially in larger areas, it's not always a requirement to replace 100% of it. You can opt for partial lawn conversion, reducing the size of your lawn or replacing high-water-use grass with drought-tolerant alternatives like certain groundcovers or native grasses. The extent of lawn removal depends on your goals for water savings, aesthetics, and how much active lawn space you wish to retain for recreation. We can help you explore various options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Complete lawn removal is not always required for water-wise landscaping. You can convert portions of your lawn or replace high-water-use grass with drought-tolerant alternatives.
